This fixture exercises matplotlib figure settings, metadata, and basic multiple
figure output. The captioned computational figure is referenced as
@fig-uv-python-captioned.

```{python}
#| label: fig-uv-python-captioned
#| fig-cap: Captioned uv-python matplotlib figure
#| fig-alt: Alt text for uv-python captioned figure
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-link: https://example.com/uv-python-figure
#| width: 60%
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
print(f"DOC_FIG_SIZE {fig.get_size_inches()[0]:.1f}x{fig.get_size_inches()[1]:.1f} DPI {fig.dpi:.0f}")
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2, 3], [1, 4, 9])
_ = ax.set_title("Document-level figure settings")
```

```{python}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 1
#| fig-dpi: 72
#| fig-format: svg
#| fig-cap: Chunk override SVG figure
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
print(f"CHUNK_FIG_SIZE {fig.get_size_inches()[0]:.1f}x{fig.get_size_inches()[1]:.1f} DPI {fig.dpi:.0f}")
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1])
_ = ax.set_title("Chunk override")
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot([0, 1], [1, 0])
_ = ax.set_title("Uncaptioned figure should not create a visible caption")
```

```{python}
#| fig-alt: Alt-only uv-python figure alt
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot([0, 1], [2, 2])
_ = ax.set_title("Alt-only figure should not create a visible caption")
```

```{python}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - First multi figure caption
#|   - Second multi figure caption
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

first = plt.figure()
ax = first.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2], [2, 3])
_ = ax.set_title("First multi figure")

second = plt.figure()
ax = second.subplots()
ax.plot([1, 2], [3, 2])
_ = ax.set_title("Second multi figure")
```

The multi-figure chunk intentionally uses a caption list with one caption per
figure and no layout/subfigure metadata.
